title: Tearing Down the Model T of Our Time - Autoline After Hours 284
summary: An Autoline After Hours episode where Sandy Munro discusses his complete teardown of the BMW i3, along with automotive journalists. It covers the car's carbon fiber construction and manufacturing technology.
why: HN recommends it as a fascinating look at the i3's revolutionary materials and production methods, and as a contrast point for Tesla.

quote.text: discussing the manufacturing tech within the i3; absolutely fascinating
